description: SVG layout check: clipping, overlaps and empty shapes from supplied geometry — Checks up to 200 SVG shapes you describe (rect, circle, ellipse, line, polygon, polyline, text, or a path's bounding box) against the viewBox and viewport the way an SVG renderer would: finds shapes clipped or entirely outside the drawn region, shapes that render nothing (zero or negative size, unstroked line), partial overlaps between shapes, and a zero, negative or malformed viewBox, for agents

checks.description: Subset of clip, empty, overlap; default all. Overlap reports partial overlaps only; a shape fully inside another (a label on a card) is listed as nested and never fails.

shapes.description: Shapes in user coordinates (no transform). rect: x,y,width,height. circle: cx,cy,r. ellipse: cx,cy,rx,ry. line: x1,y1,x2,y2,strokeWidth. polygon/polyline: points. text: x,y,text,fontSize,textAnchor. bbox: bbox [minX,minY,maxX,maxY] for a path you measured yourself.

width.description: Viewport width in px (the svg width attribute).

name: svg-geometry
